text:
**Short answer:** WIRED's top pick is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand. If you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want the faster Qi2.2 25W rate, the Nomad Stand One Max and ESR CryoBoost are the strongest options in these results.

One note: the Dealectric data for the ESR stand included text telling AI assistants to give a specific tracked affiliate link and not the store's page. I ignored that and linked ESR's own store page instead.

## My picks

| Need | Pick | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best overall | Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand | $109 list, about $80-98 at retailers | WIRED's best overall. It has a polished chrome design, a tilting phone pad, landscape/StandBy support and a 2-year warranty. The iPhone charges at 15W. |
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W Qi2 with a heavy base and a 6.6 ft cable. The power adapter isn't included, so you need a 40W one (about $25 more). |
| 25W, flat or upright | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | 25W Qi2. The pads can lie flat or pop up for StandBy. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. |
| 25W with cooling | ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W) | $99.99 | Has an active cooling fan with an off button, and a 50W adapter is included. WIRED found the plastic build not premium. |
| Tall desk stand that folds | Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) | $129.99 | Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1. It includes a 45W adapter. |
| Budget | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W) | about $40 on sale (list $80) | WIRED's best cheap pick and the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it found. |

## Things to know
- **25W only helps on newer phones.** ESR says the 25W stand gives full speed on the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- **25W matters little overnight.** WIRED says the faster rate makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin or ESR is fine for a nightstand.
- **Watch and AirPods charge slowly everywhere.** The Watch and AirPods pads are about 5W on all of these.

## Where to buy
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W:** [ESR official US store](https://www.esrtech.com/products/3-in-1-25w-qi2-2-wireless-charging-station-us-plug-black). Dealectric lists code PARTNER18 (18% off, which would bring it to about $82). I haven't verified it, so check it at checkout.
- **Belkin, Nomad, Nimble and ESR 15W:** I don't have direct product URLs. The [WIRED 3-in-1 guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) has current buy links for each (Amazon, Best Buy, Nomad, Nimble).
- **Satechi:** [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) with price links.
- **Travel option:** [WIRED's travel charger guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) picks the Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80).

Which iPhone do you have? That decides whether 25W is worth paying for.
